plugins.description: MCPBox agent stack for Claude Code. One MCP server (https://mcpbox.ru/v1/mcp) exposing the daruma tracker tools plus the platform pipeline (torii→satori→enma→yatagarasu→fujin→daruma). Ships /mcpbox:{tasks,plan,next,mine,status,close,sync,capture,doctor,mode} + pipeline commands, SessionStart/Stop/UserPromptSubmit hooks, and a managed CLAUDE.md policy covering the full maturity stack.
